analogy.rationale: Respiratory stimulants act mainly on brainstem chemoreceptors and peripheral chemoreceptors, targets that are not represented among the 978 landmark genes in these cell lines, so little or no transcriptional response is expected. Other neuroactive receptor classes that also act on poorly expressed neuronal receptors should similarly show minimal response.
